reuse.why: Reuses the existing extractTagsFromText tag parser and the existing getMonthActionCategories selection, adding one small getFixedGroupIds helper.

duplication.why: The fixed-group exclusion is applied twice (filter in getMonthActionCategories and an inline condition in copyPreviousMonth), extending the pre-existing duplicated skip rule instead of consolidating it, though both share getFixedGroupIds.

placement.why: The logic sits next to the existing month-action category selection in budget/actions.ts, where this tree keeps that rule.

scope.why: Focused on the request; narrowing getMonthActionCategories' select/return type is a small incidental change.

maintainability.why: Readable, but the skip rule still lives in two code paths that must be kept in sync, and filtering in JS after SQL splits the rule across layers.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getMonthActionCategories and extractTagsFromText; copyPreviousMonth's separate check pre-exists the change.

disguised_duplication.where: The second check in copyPreviousMonth is an openly parallel condition next to the existing hidden/goal_def checks, not disguised.

one_place.where: Rule added in getMonthActionCategories (JS filter) and again inline in copyPreviousMonth's skip condition; only the group-id lookup is shared.
